loyal.d: unwavering in devotion to friend or vow or cause

loyalty.d: the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action

loyalist.d: a person who is loyal to their allegiance (especially in times of revolt)

loyola.d: Spaniard and Roman Catholic theologian and founder of the Society of Jesus; a leading opponent of the Reformation (1491-1556)

loyang.d: a city in east central China; the capital of ancient China during several dynasties
